salary.name: salary
salary.meaning: Annual compensation amount for the employee.

table.name: d_baseball_1__hall_of_fame
table.summary: Records of individuals inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame, detailing their voting statistics, induction status, and category.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a specific player record in the database.

yearid.name: yearid
yearid.meaning: The year in which the player was considered for or inducted into the Hall of Fame.

votedby.name: votedby
votedby.meaning: The organization or group responsible for casting the votes for this specific record.

ballots.name: ballots
ballots.meaning: The total number of ballots cast by the voting body for this specific election cycle.

needed.name: needed
needed.meaning: The minimum number of votes required to be inducted into the Hall of Fame for that specific election.

votes.name: votes
votes.meaning: The number of votes received by the player in the specific election.

inducted.name: inducted
inducted.meaning: Indicates whether the player was successfully inducted into the Hall of Fame.

category.name: category
category.meaning: The classification of the inductee (e.g., Player, Manager, Executive).

needed_note.name: needed_note
needed_note.meaning: Additional explanatory text regarding the vote threshold or special circumstances for the election.
